description: Environment variables (definitions and values) and connection references.

solution.description: Unique name of the unmanaged solution new definitions go into. Its publisher decides the prefix.

schemaName.description: Schema name with the publisher prefix, for example con_ApiUrl.

type.description: Fixed when created. Default string. Secret variables need Azure Key Vault and are set in the maker portal.

value.description: The current value in this environment.

logicalName.description: Logical name with the publisher prefix, for example con_sharedoffice365.

connector.description: The connector, for example shared_office365. Fixed when created.

connectionId.description: The connection to use (its name in the maker portal). An agent cannot create connections.
